defect: The fix corrects the typo 'calues' in an assertion message.
reason: A message typo is cosmetic, and the typo was already in the line before this change, which only rewrapped it.

defect: The fix makes RefinementOperator::MultTranspose use doftrans->InvTransformDual and old_DoFTrans->TransformDual instead of the primal transforms.
reason: The wrong choice (old InvTransformPrimal before, new TransformPrimal after) was already there before this change, which only switched to in-place calls.

defect: Once data became Array<real_t>, SetSize only calls data.SetSize when s2 > Capacity(), so growing within capacity leaves the array's logical size stale (Read/Write and debug bounds checks then use the wrong size).
reason: The capacity check was harmless with the old Memory<real_t> and breaks with the Array this change introduced in the header; the fix calls data.SetSize every time.

defect: The fix removes unused MAX_D1D constants and uses the local MAX_D1D in place of HDIV_MAX_D1D, to silence compiler warnings.
reason: Unused-variable warnings are not a defect in behaviour, so this is a style fix.

defect: refiner.SetType(ref_type) passes a BasisType value where GeometryRefiner expects a Quadrature1D type, so closed-uniform LOR refines with the wrong point type.
reason: This change added the local GeometryRefiner and the SetType call; the fix converts with BasisType::GetQuadrature1D, and seeing the mismatch requires knowing that SetType takes a Quadrature1D type.

defect: The fix changes static_cast<FiniteElementSpace> (a sliced copy) to static_cast<FiniteElementSpace&>.
reason: The by-value cast was already in the original line; this style commit only rewrapped it.

defect: The added NonConformingMaster clause is ANDed only with the Interior branch, because of a missing pair of parentheses around the Interior||Boundary disjunction, so boundary faces skip the check.
reason: This change added the clause with wrong parenthesization, which is plain from the diff; the fix adds the missing parentheses.

defect: The fix parenthesizes the NonConformingMaster && (Interior || Boundary) condition.
reason: This change did not add the NonConformingMaster clause; the later commit f87ce97 added it with the bad parentheses.

defect: The fix parenthesizes the NonConformingMaster && (Interior || Boundary) condition in GetNFbyType.
reason: This change's condition had no NonConformingMaster clause; commit f87ce97 later added it with the bad parentheses.

defect: The new KVExt2KV calls KnotVector::Difference before handling an order mismatch, and Difference cannot compare knot vectors of different orders.
reason: KVExt2KV was added in this change; the fix handles diffo first, and seeing the problem requires knowing what KnotVector::Difference supports.

defect: The fix renames the misnamed 'Nonlinear Convection' test case and splits it into vector mass and vector diffusion cases.
reason: The fix only renames and reorganizes tests; nothing behaves differently.

defect: The fix replaces the bitwise & with && between two bool comparisons (a pedantic warning).
reason: Bitwise & on bools gives the same result, and the & was there before this change anyway.

defect: The fix stops the unit test from writing the output file cheby.dat.
reason: This is test-output hygiene, not a wrong result or a crash.

defect: FaceMatrixInt::AddMult adds the product of block 0 with X side 0 into Y side 1 and block 1 with side 1 into side 0, so the face sides are swapped.
reason: This change added the swapped indices and the fix swaps them back; telling which side is right requires the face matrix data layout defined elsewhere.

defect: The fix removes an unused variable and changes loop counters to size_t to silence warnings.
reason: This fixes compiler warnings only.

defect: The new segment NewtonElementProject solver sets the result to Inside when the point was projected onto the boundary (hit_bdr) and Outside otherwise, which is the wrong way round; it also overwrites phys_coord instead of accumulating it.
reason: The specialization was added in this change; the fix (02aed48) inverts the hit_bdr ternary, and an earlier follow-up fixed the accumulation; the inverted classification is readable in the diff.

defect: The fix moves the brace and re-indents AddNewtonSolveSpecialization.
reason: The fix to this file is formatting only.

defect: GeometryUtils<CUBE>::project clamps y instead of z when z is out of range (copy-paste error).
reason: This change added the z branch that assigns y = 0 and y = 1, which is plain in the diff; the fix assigns z.

defect: In this file the fix only renames f_exact and f_exact_vec to f and f_vec.
reason: A rename is not a defect fix; the real bug the commit repairs (a coefficient declared in an inner scope and used after it ends) is in the caller files.

defect: The fix removes the unused K member and parameter from DG_Solver.
reason: This only removes unused-variable warnings; the unused member was there before this style commit.

defect: The fix adds MFEM_EXPORT to the static Types strings and the Select functions, for Windows shared-library builds.
reason: The static member ODETypes that these replace was also unexported and was already used by ex9, so the missing export was there before this change.

defect: The test calls a nonexistent function HypreUseGPU() instead of HypreUsingGPU(), so the unit test does not compile with MPI and hypre >= 2.19.
reason: This change added the misspelled call, and the fix corrects the name; seeing it requires knowing the real API name.

defect: REQUIRE((a == b != 0)) parses as ((a == b) != 0), so the intended non-empty check never runs and the test passes even when both sizes are zero.
reason: This change added the precedence mistake, which is visible in the diff; the fix splits it into a size > 0 check and an equality check.

defect: After the restructuring, the else branch calls MQ->Eval whenever Q is null, which dereferences a null pointer when neither Q nor MQ is supplied.
reason: This change reordered the branches so that the no-coefficient case falls into the MQ branch; the fix restores an MQ / Q / none chain.

defect: The fix makes the marker-size check compare against attributes.Max() instead of attributes.Size().
reason: This formatting commit only rewrapped the existing wrong check.

defect: The fix makes the domain marker-size check compare against attributes.Max() instead of attributes.Size().
reason: The check was already wrong before this change, which only renamed dlfi_marker to domain_integs_marker.

defect: The new test_multiplicity reciprocal and the xscaled scaling loop index Vectors on the host with operator(), without HostReadWrite, after device MultTranspose; on GPU builds they read stale data.
reason: These loops were added in this change, and the fix moves them into MFEM_FORALL with Read/ReadWrite; host-side indexing of device vectors is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix adds BuildTranspose before the serial assembled MultTranspose and retags the serial test [CUDA].
reason: The serial comparison lines were already there before this change, and the fix is a test configuration change for device runs.

defect: The fix uses the SpMat with BuildTranspose for the transpose comparison and retags the test [CUDA].
reason: This adapts the test to device runs; the form's MultTranspose that this change used computes the same product as the SpMat's, so there is no defect in the test's logic.

defect: The new PRISM case uses an undeclared identifier Time (typo for Times) and an undeclared variable m, so it does not compile.
reason: This change added both errors, and they are plain in the diff; the fix corrects Times and declares m.

defect: The fix goes back to stepping with a local dt_real instead of clamping and passing dt.
reason: The revert goes with a change in PetscODESolver::Step semantics (it now returns the step actually taken), so it adapts the example to an API change rather than repairing a defect of this change.

defect: The fix replaces the debugging refinement block with new uniform and random refinement options.
reason: This is a feature and cleanup of a demo's debugging code, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix extends the test (curved mesh, higher order, parallel cases) along with new FieldInterpolant functionality.
reason: The test evolved through many intermediate commits, and the fix is a test and feature change, not a repair of a defect this change introduced.

defect: In the parallel BR2 setup the offset arrays are not resized for face-neighbor elements (out-of-bounds writes), the loop uses i <= GetNE() instead of i < GetNE(), the transformation uses index i instead of inbr, and ExchangeFaceNbrData is not called.
reason: All of these are in the new file this change added, and most of them are visible in the diff; the fix repairs them.

defect: The setup kernels reshape COEFF as (NQ, NE) and read C(q,e) even when the coefficient is a size-1 vector (null or constant Q), which reads out of bounds.
reason: This change introduced the vector coefficient with size-1 constant cases and the unconditional (NQ, NE) reshape; the fix adds the const_c branch.

defect: #elif with no condition breaks the preprocessor, and MPI_Comm is used unconditionally, so the serial build fails.
reason: This change created the header with these errors, plainly visible; the fix uses #else and guards the MPI_Comm member.

defect: SegDofOrd[1] negates the z-directed (non-tangential) edge dofs for reversed orientation, although those dofs should only be reordered, not sign-flipped.
reason: The new ND_P2D collection added this ordering, and the fix removes the sign flip; judging it requires knowing that the z-component dofs of ND_P2D_SegmentElement are scalar-like.

defect: With MFEM_USE_MPI, LumpedMassInverse always uses pfes_lor_scalar, which is null when the serial L2ProjectionH1Space constructor was used, so serial use in an MPI build fails.
reason: This change added the #ifdef selection, and the fix falls back to fes_lor_scalar when pfes is null; seeing it requires knowing which constructor sets which pointer.

defect: The new ParNCL2FaceRestriction::AddMultTranspose accumulates into y obtained with y.Write(), which does not keep existing contents on device, so the add is wrong.
reason: The function was added in this change, and the fix changes Write to ReadWrite; Write followed by += is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix changes the finalization logic in NewParallelConformingInterpolation (owned or slave dofs, sending only shared owned rows), removes an assertion, and reformats DebugDumpDOFs.
reason: The finalization condition the fix changes was already in the code before this change, which only added debugging code.
